review_candidates.description: Engineer (Piping/Mechanical) We are looking for a highly skilled Engineer (Piping/Mechanical) to support the engineering, installation, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of complex Oil & Gas EPC projects . This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale multidisciplinary projects involving piping systems, mechanical equipment, pipelines, and process facilities across the energy and infrastructure sectors. YOUR ROLE As Engineer (Piping/Mechanical), will play a key role in the design, analysis, material selection, construction support, testing, and commissioning of piping systems while ensuring compliance with international standards, project specifications, safety requirements, schedules, and budgets. Piping System Design & Engineering Design and develop detailed engineering solutions for piping systems in compliance with ASME, API, ANSI, and project-specific standards. Review and interpret P&IDs, piping layouts, isometrics, and construction drawings. Perform piping stress analysis, flow calculations, and engineering evaluations. Develop technical specifications for pipes, valves, fittings, supports, and associated mechanical components. Ensure piping systems are designed for optimal safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Material Selection & Procurement Support Select appropriate piping materials based on pressure, temperature, corrosion resistance, and process requirements. Prepare material requisitions, technical evaluations, and procurement documentation. Coordinate with procurement teams and vendors to ensure timely material delivery. Support material inspections and ensure proper storage and handling practices on site. Installation & Construction Support Provide technical guidance during piping fabrication, installation, and construction activities. Review and approve installation methodologies and work procedures. Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, and construction teams to resolve technical issues. Monitor welding, fabrication, material control, and installation activities to ensure compliance with approved standards and specifications. Participate in site inspections and construction progress reviews. Testing & Inspection Supervise hydrostatic, pneumatic, pressure, and leak testing activities. Review test packages and ensure successful execution of all testing requirements. Conduct inspections and assess piping system integrity and compliance. Ensure all identified defects, punch-list items, and non-conformities are rectified promptly. Verify that testing documentation meets client and regulatory requirements. Commissioning & Handover Support and supervise pre-commissioning and commissioning activities. Ensure piping systems are fully operational and compliant with project specifications. Collaborate with commissioning teams to achieve successful system startup. Review and validate as-built drawings, inspection records, and turnover documentation. Ensure smooth project handover to clients and operations teams. Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Construction Managers, Designers, QA/QC personnel, and Procurement teams. Provide technical updates and engineering support throughout project execution. Coordinate multidisciplinary activities to ensure seamless project delivery. Monitor engineering deliverables, schedules, budgets, and project milestones. Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with HSE regulations and company policies. Participate in risk assessments, hazard identification, and mitigation planning. Promote a strong safety culture throughout engineering and construction phases. Support HSE audits, inspections, and compliance initiatives. Documentation & Reporting Maintain complete engineering and project documentation. Prepare technical reports, calculations, specifications, and progress updates. Track project schedules, resources, and engineering deliverables. Ensure accurate record keeping for regulatory, client, and internal requirements. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience Must have 6-8 years of experience in piping and mechanical engineering within the Oil & Gas EPC industry . Proven experience in piping design, installation, testing, commissioning, and construction support. Experience working on large-scale EPC projects in Oil & Gas, Power, Marine, Industrial Plant, or Infrastructure sectors. Education and Certifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering , or a related discipline. Professional certifications in Piping, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields are advantageous. Skills and Competencies Strong knowledge of international standards including: ASME, API, ANSI, Relevant industry codes and regulations. Proficiency in: AutoCAD, SmartPlant 3D, Other piping design and drafting software Experience with: P&ID reviews, Material selection, Stress analysis, Pipe flow calculations, Pipeline and process piping systems Strong understanding of piping materials including: Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, HDPE, Other specialty piping materials Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent technical and engineering judgment. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities within fast-paced project environments. Strong commitment to quality, safety, and operational excellence. WHAT WE OFFER The chance to contribute to some of UAE’s Oil and Gas EPC Mega projects. A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Competitive salary and benefits package. Ready to be part of our team? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success. Apply today and be part of something excellent!

review_candidates.title: Assistant, Human Resources
review_candidates.company: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies - IFRC
review_candidates.description: Organizational Context The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian network, with 191 member National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. IFRC uses the Triple R – response, resilience and respect – to deliver on Strategy 2030. IFRC responds to disasters and crises, ensuring timely, coordinated and locally led humanitarian action. IFRC supports its members in building community resilience in the areas of climate and environment, health and wellbeing, and migration and displacement. IFRC promotes respect for our fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality, including in our work on values, power and inclusion. The IFRC focuses throughout on our core mandate – our raison d’être – of strategic and operational coordination, humanitarian diplomacy, National Society development, and accountability. IFRC is led by its Secretary General and has its Headquarters in Geneva and five regional offices in Africa (Nairobi); the Americas (Panama); Asia Pacific (Kuala Lumpur); Europe (Budapest); and MENA (Beirut) as well as representation offices, service centres and delegations across the globe. The IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. The IFRC Country Cluster Delegation (CCD) based in Ankara, Türkiye supports the Turkish, Georgian, Armenian and Azeri, Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. It provides direct support and facilitates organizational development, technical capacity strengthening, partnerships, and resource mobilization, enabling National Societies to deliver in accordance with Strategy 2030 and their annual plans. As a Country Cluster Delegation, it supports progress towards global indicators, fosters active membership engagement, and hosts technical outposted staff. Job Purpose The position holder will provide administrative and operational support to Human Resources functions, ensuring the accurate and timely implementation of recruitment, employee administration, onboarding, payroll support, records management, and staff separation processes. The position holder will maintain HR data, personnel records, and documentation in compliance with organizational procedures and standards. The incumbent will support the delivery of efficient HR services through effective record management, stakeholder coordination, and administrative support for local and international staff. In addition, the position holder will contribute to the smooth functioning of HR operations and provide administrative support to the Administration team as required. Job Duties And Responsibilities Human Resources (80%): All tasks under this section will be carried out under the management and guidance of the Team Leader, Human Resources . Talent Acquisition Administration Provide administrative support to recruitment and selection activities, including preparing vacancy announcements, arranging interviews, collecting candidate documentation, supporting reference checks, preparing offer letters and contracts, and assisting with onboarding-related documentation. Maintain recruitment trackers and update recruitment records and data in the Lumesse system. Assist in preparing recruitment-related documentation, reports, correspondence, and filing. Collect, verify, file, and archive candidate and recruitment documentation in accordance with established procedures and record-keeping requirements. Process recruitment-related data entries in D365 and maintain accurate recruitment records and documentation. HR Administration Prepare HR documentation, including employment contracts, consultancy agreements, amendment letters, employment certificates, and related correspondence, while maintaining physical and electronic personnel files and HR records. Maintain HR archives in both hard-copy and electronic formats, ensuring documents are properly filed and stored according to established procedures. Assist in preparing and collecting personnel documentation for local and international staff. Assist with onboarding arrangements and preparation of onboarding documentation for new employees. Provide administrative support for the preparation of monthly payroll documentation and related HR records. Update employee information and records in D365, including personal, employment, position, and organizational data, in accordance with established procedures. Assist with end-of-mission administrative processes, including preparation, collection, filing, and archiving of exit-related documentation and scheduling of exit interviews when requested. Contribute to HR-related Internal and External Communication Assist with the preparation and distribution of HR-related communication materials. Support the dissemination of information related to HR policies, procedures, systems, and initiatives. Provide administrative support in communication and documentation exchange with payroll, insurance, pension, occupational health and safety, and other HR service providers. Maintain HR-related documents, templates, policies, and guidance materials to ensure they are properly organized and accessible. Contribution to Building an Effective, High-Quality HR Team Assist with maintaining accurate HR records and data within organizational systems. Follow established HR processes and support the maintenance of HR documentation and administrative procedures. Ensure HR documentation is filed and archived in accordance with organizational requirements. Provide administrative back-up support during the absence of other team members as assigned. Contribute to effective teamwork and knowledge sharing within the HR team. Undertake additional responsibilities and assignments delegated by the Team Leader, Human Resources, and contribute to the effective delivery of HR operations and services. Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued) Administration (20%): All tasks under this section will be carried out under the management and guidance of the Senior Officer, Administration . Administration Support Prepare start-of-mission and end-of-mission Travel Orders for international staff. Liaise with third-party service providers to arrange IFRC identification cards for newly recruited staff and employees assuming new positions. Prepare and distribute visibility packs to staff following the commencement of their employment. Support the Admin Team to have accurate records and documentation related to administrative support activities and ensure proper filing and archiving. Education Required: University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Economics or any relevant field. Preferred: Professional qualification in HR and registered with a professional HR Body. Experience Required: 1 to 3 years of experience in Human Resources, Office Administration, or in any other relevant office support areas Experience of facilitating recruitment and onboarding processes Experience of handling confidential information Preferred: Basic understanding of Turkish Labour Law and employment-related regulations relevant to HR administration and personnel record management. Experience of working for the Red Cross and Red Crescent Experience working with governmental and international non-governmental organizations, authorities and agencies Knowledge, Skills and Languages Required: Proficiency in the usage of computers and office software packages (Office 365, MS Word, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, etc.) Ability to communicate with internal employees and external associates on all levels Ability to work in a cross-cultural, cross-functional and multi-cultural environment Ability to work with complete integrity and confidentiality Excellent organizational, planning and influencing skills Good verbal and written communication skills Good level of attention to detail and ability to prioritise, meet deadlines and work under pressure Customer service Demonstrated core proficiency in (a) digital communication & collaboration, (b) basic digital content creation, (c) digital safety & security, (d) data literacy, and (e) problem solving with technology (including responsible use of AI assistants. Understanding of and commitment to IFRC’s mission and values. Fluent spoken and written English and Turkish Preferred: Good command of another IFRC official language (French, Spanish or Arabic) Competencies, Values and Comments Values: Respect for diversity; Integrity; Professionalism; Accountability Core competencies: Communication; Collaboration and teamwork; Judgement and decision making; National society and customer relations; Creativity and innovation; Building trust Only candidates who have the legal right to work in Türkiye will be considered for this position.
